user.title: MAST water meter
user.description: Sign in at [mast.co.il]({mast_url}). In the site's browser console, run `copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user')||'{{}}').token)` and paste the result into Session token. Chrome and Firefox may ask you to type `allow pasting` before pasting the snippet into the console.

company.title: Choose your water corporation
company.description: Your account has access to multiple water corporations. Pick the one to import.

card.title: Choose your water card
card.description: Pick the water meter card to import. If your cards could not be listed automatically, type the card number.

reconfigure.title: Update session token
reconfigure.description: To update the session token, sign in at [mast.co.il]({mast_url}). In the site's browser console, run `copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user')||'{{}}').token)` and paste the result below. Chrome and Firefox may ask you to type `allow pasting` before pasting the snippet. Leave blank to keep the current token.

reauth_confirm.title: MAST session needs sign-in
reauth_confirm.description: MAST could not renew this session. Sign in at [mast.co.il]({mast_url}). In the site's browser console, run `copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user')||'{{}}').token)` and paste the result into Session token. Chrome and Firefox may ask you to type `allow pasting` before pasting the snippet.

error.invalid_card: MAST returned an error. Check the card number.
error.no_data: The request worked but returned no readings.
error.invalid_user_token: MAST rejected the session token or it cannot access this water card.
error.assets_invalid: MAST says the account assets are not valid.
error.mast_error: MAST returned an error. Try again.
error.invalid_company: MAST does not accept this Company ID for your account. Use the X-CompanyId request header value, or the number in the site address mast.co.il/COMPANY_ID/services.

abort.already_configured: This water card is already configured.
abort.no_daily_readings: Your water corporation ({company}) provides billing-period consumption only. This integration needs daily readings, so it can’t be set up for this account yet.

billing_total_price.name: Last billing period amount before VAT
